question.worked_solution:
Given the complex number $a+b\,\text{i},$ $a$ represents its real part while $b$ represents its imaginary part.

To add or subtract complex numbers, we add or subtract their real parts, and we add or subtract their imaginary parts.

For the given problem, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}(-5+12\,\text{i})+(6-9\,\text{i}) & =(-5+6)+(12+(-9))\,\text{i} \\  & =(-5+6)+(12-9)\,\text{i} \\  & =1+3\,\text{i}.\end{aligned}
$$
